name: mech-89-power-gloves-room
source: mech-89-power-gloves Test Level: power gloves pickup (g) in a slot, a heavy block (H) to push east onto a switch plate (S), a single push block (B, lower row), and the teaching line of three blocks (BBB, middle row) ending one tile from a wall (# one tile beyond the free floor) - without the gloves the line does not shift, with them it shifts onto the free tile and a second shove jams against the wall, teaching that the tile beyond the far block decides the whole line
